top_signals.title: Sprake: Markets Punch-Drunk on AI Capex Spend
top_signals.summary:
Brent crude held below 80 dollars a barrel on hopes for progress towards a Hormuz deal, while Treasury yields remained lower as easing oil prices reduced pressure on the Federal Reserve. AG Capital's Market Strategist Casey Sprake spoke to Bloomberg’s Abeer Abu Omar on Horizons Middle East & Africa on the market moves.
 (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Hackers Target Hedge Funds, Iran Says Deal Reached with Oman | The Opening Trade 8/6/2026
top_signals.summary:
Hackers launched a wave of sophisticated attacks on Wall Street firms in recent days, targeting information systems at major money managers, according to people familiar with the matter.

Iran said it had reached an agreement with Oman on a proposed route for shipping through the Strait of Hormuz, a potential step toward a reopening of the critical waterway for energy supplies. 

The Opening Trade has everything you need to know as markets open across Europe. With analysis you won't find anywhere else, we break down the biggest stories of the day and speak to top guests who have skin in the game. Hosted by Anna Edwards and Lizzy Burden. (Source: Bloomberg)
